title: Extraction Protocol for Untargeted LC-MS/MS from Milk Samples
author: Mauricio Caraballo
materials: Store all extraction reagents at 4 °C or -20 °C (colder is better).
1 micromolar (µM) sulfadimethoxine is an internal standard.
Ideally at 4 °C to keep samples cold.

steps.title: Prepare metadata table
steps.instruction: Create a metadata table using the ReDU2 template and fill it with all required information for each sample, including the NCBI taxonomy (e.g., 1313|Streptococcus pneumoniae) and, when available, reference‑compound details as described in the MSMS‑Chooser documentation.

steps.title: Aliquot milk into deep‑well plate
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of each milk sample to individual wells of a 96‑well deep‑well plate. Thaw milk samples at 4 °C (may take up to 1 day). Ensure all samples have the same volume to maintain extraction efficiency.

steps.title: Add cold MeOH/MTBE solvent
steps.instruction: To each well add 400 µL of cold 75:25 MeOH/MTBE containing 1 µM sulfadimethoxine. For smaller sample volumes adjust proportionally (e.g., 25 µL milk → 200 µL solvent).

steps.title: Sonicate samples
steps.instruction: Place the deep‑well plate in a water‑bath sonicator (plates float) and sonicate for 5 minutes (00:05:00).

steps.title: Centrifuge plate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the plate for more than 15 minutes (00:15:00) at 1800 rpm, the maximum speed achievable with the 96‑well plate rotor.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to shallow plate
steps.instruction: Carefully pipette 200 µL of the clear supernatant from each well into a new shallow 96‑well plate, avoiding any protein pellet to prevent column clogging. The shallow plate is now ready for LC‑MS/MS acquisition.

steps.title: Prepare pool QC sample
steps.instruction: Take 20 µL from each sample, combine into a single vial or centrifuge tube, then add 200 µL of this pooled mixture to one or more wells of the shallow plate. This pooled well will serve as the PoolQC reference.

steps.title: Store plates until analysis
steps.instruction: If the shallow plate is not analyzed immediately, store it at –80 °C until LC‑MS/MS acquisition. For longer‑term storage, dry down the extracts before freezing.
